title: Hoelder bound of the q-th power integral by the scaled L^p norm on a larger ball
statement: Let n, ℓ be natural numbers, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} any subset, V a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) with weight μ := V.weight, H : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ^{n+ℓ} any function, and K(y, r) := V.scaledLpNorm H p y r = (ofReal(r^{p-n}) · ∫⁻_{B̄_r(y)} ‖H‖ₑ^p dμ)^{1/p} ∈ [0, ∞] (closed balls, lower integrals). If 0 < q ≤ p, t > 0, m ≥ 0, B̄_s(z) ⊆ B̄_t(w) and μ(B̄_s(z)) ≤ ofReal(m), then ∫⁻_{B̄_s(z)} ‖H‖ₑ^q dμ ≤ ofReal(m^{1-q/p} · t^{q(n-p)/p}) · K(w, t)^q, where K(w, t)^q is the real power in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p q : ℝ) (z w : Amb n ℓ) (s t m : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ p → 0 < t → 0 ≤ m → closedBall z s ⊆ closedBall w t → V.weight (closedBall z s) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal m → ∫⁻ x in closedBall z s, ‖H x‖ₑ ^ q ∂V.weight ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (m ^ (1 - q / p) * t ^ (q * (n - p) / p)) * V.scaledLpNorm H p w t ^ q
